exercise_source_shape_valid.name: exercise_source_shape_valid
exercise_source_shape_valid.value:
(
        "fitness"."exercise_source"."source_kind" = 'system'
        AND "fitness"."exercise_source"."user_id" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."exercise_source"."provider_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "fitness"."exercise_source"."source_kind" = 'user'
        AND "fitness"."exercise_source"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."exercise_source"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

webhook_subscription_user_provider_idx.name: webhook_subscription_user_provider_idx
webhook_subscription_user_provider_idx.where: "fitness"."webhook_subscription"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fitness"."webhook_subscription"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fitness"."webhook_subscription"."status" = 'active'

activity_local_time_context_check.name: activity_local_time_context_check
activity_local_time_context_check.value:
(
        "fitness"."activity"."local_time_source" = 'unknown'
        AND "fitness"."activity"."start_utc_offset_minutes" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity"."end_utc_offset_minutes" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "fitness"."activity"."local_time_source" IN (
          'provider_timezone',
          'device_timezone',
          'user_home_timezone',
          'gps_timezone',
          'home_zone_fallback'
        )
        AND NULLIF(btrim("fitness"."activity"."timezone"), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity"."start_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840
        AND ("fitness"."activity"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "fitness"."activity"."end_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840)
      ) OR (
        "fitness"."activity"."local_time_source" IN ('provider_offset', 'device_offset')
        AND "fitness"."activity"."timezone" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity"."start_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840
        AND ("fitness"."activity"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "fitness"."activity"."end_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840)
      )

activity_interval_inferred_targets.name: activity_interval_inferred_targets
activity_interval_inferred_targets.value:
"fitness"."activity_interval"."source_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'inferred' OR (
        "fitness"."activity_interval"."target_intensity" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_interval"."target_zone" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_interval"."target_cadence_rpm" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_interval"."target_power_watts" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_interval"."target_resistance" IS NULL
      )

climbing_attempt_failure_reason.name: climbing_attempt_failure_reason
climbing_attempt_failure_reason.value:
("fitness"."climbing_attempt"."outcome" = 'sent' AND "fitness"."climbing_attempt"."failure_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("fitness"."climbing_attempt"."outcome" = 'failed' AND "fitness"."climbing_attempt"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL)

sleep_session_local_time_context_check.name: sleep_session_local_time_context_check
sleep_session_local_time_context_check.value:
(
        "fitness"."sleep_session"."local_time_source" = 'unknown'
        AND "fitness"."sleep_session"."timezone" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."sleep_session"."start_utc_offset_minutes" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."sleep_session"."end_utc_offset_minutes" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "fitness"."sleep_session"."local_time_source" IN ('provider_timezone', 'device_timezone', 'user_home_timezone')
        AND NULLIF(btrim("fitness"."sleep_session"."timezone"), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."sleep_session"."start_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840
        AND ("fitness"."sleep_session"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "fitness"."sleep_session"."end_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840)
      ) OR (
        "fitness"."sleep_session"."local_time_source" IN ('provider_offset', 'device_offset')
        AND "fitness"."sleep_session"."timezone" IS NULL
        AND "fitness"."sleep_session"."start_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840
        AND ("fitness"."sleep_session"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "fitness"."sleep_session"."end_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840)
      )

external_client_active_owner_check.name: external_client_active_owner_check
external_client_active_owner_check.value: "fitness"."external_client"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "fitness"."external_client"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

activity_integrity_repair_journal_retire.name: activity_integrity_repair_journal_retirement_complete
activity_integrity_repair_journal_retire.value:
("fitness"."activity_integrity_repair_journal"."phase" = 'retired') = (
        "fitness"."activity_integrity_repair_journal"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_integrity_repair_journal"."retirement_disposition" IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_integrity_repair_journal"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_integrity_repair_journal"."retirement_receipt_path" IS NOT NULL
        AND "fitness"."activity_integrity_repair_journal"."retirement_receipt_checksum" IS NOT NULL
      )

human_food_nutrient_decision_value_valid.name: human_food_nutrient_decision_value_valid
human_food_nutrient_decision_value_valid.value:
("fitness"."human_food_nutrient_decision"."operation" = 'clear' AND "fitness"."human_food_nutrient_decision"."amount" IS NULL)
          OR ("fitness"."human_food_nutrient_decision"."operation" = 'set' AND ("fitness"."human_food_nutrient_decision"."amount" IS NULL OR "fitness"."human_food_nutrient_decision"."amount" >= 0))
